import sys

class TreeNode:
    __slots__ = ('val', 'left', 'right')
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val = val
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def build(l, r):
    if l > r:
        return None
    mid = (l + r) // 2
    node = TreeNode(nums[mid])
    node.left = build(l, mid - 1)
    node.right = build(mid + 1, r)
    return node

def preorder(root):
    res = []
    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            return
        res.append(str(node.val))
        dfs(node.left)
        dfs(node.right)
    dfs(root)
    return res

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    global nums
    nums = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    root = build(0, n - 1)
    out = preorder(root)
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
